# HarnMem synonym table v1 (English)
# Purpose: BM25 query expansion for English queries. English tokenization is word-based, so the same-meaning-rewording gap is much smaller than in Chinese; this table therefore stays small.
# Format: canonical<TAB>syn1,syn2,...   — exactly one ASCII TAB; the second column is comma-separated with no spaces around commas.
# Rules:
#   - canonical is unique across the file; synonyms within a row must not repeat, and must not equal the canonical.
#   - English terms are lowercase; no explanatory content.
#   - Terms may contain spaces (e.g. rate limit, pull request); no spaces around commas.
#   - Lines may cross-reference each other; expansion is one-hop and deduplicated, never transitive closure.
#   - Used only for query expansion, never changes stored text; terms hit through expansion are down-weighted in scoring (see docs/design/03-retrieval.md).
#   - Keep the shipped table generic (common development/AI vocabulary). Personal or project-specific terms belong in the user's <home>/data/synonyms.en.txt copy, never in the repository.
# Language files: the engine loads every data/synonyms.<lang>.txt it finds (this file = English, data/synonyms.zh.txt = Chinese); the <home> copy of a filename overrides the shipped default of the same name. Add a language by adding data/synonyms.<lang>.txt — no code change.
# Maintenance: add rows grouped by topic; verify changes with a reworded `harnmem search` query. The repository eval suite uses its own fixture (evals/data/synonyms.zh.tsv), so it does not cover edits to this file.
